newsitem.title: GERMANY: Compaq forms European comm products group.
newsitem.headline: Compaq forms European comm products group.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said on Monday it had formed a new product group to concentrate on its lines of networking and communications products in Europe.

"This organisation change allows us to prioritise what is a fast-growing and strategic business for Compaq, and to fully align Europe with the company's corporate structure," said Andreas Barth, general manager for Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

Compaq, the world's top personal computer maker, also said Bruno Didier, head of PC products for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, would leave the company to pursue a new career in France. Compaq did not say if a replacement was named.
The new communications group would be headed by Patrick Lelorieux, who joined Compaq from Hewlett-Packard Co.'s workgroup networking products business.
Compaq's communications products include networking adapters, modems, hubs, routers and repeaters.
